safety_lead_time.comparison_action: reduce — SAP safety lead time of 2.0 days is above the statistically derived recommendation of 0.98 days

narrative: Material PL1__M9E287CB shows erratic, high-volume demand averaging 12,083 units per working day with a CV of 0.42 and a statistically significant upward trend. Lead times are unstable (CV = 0.665), making combined demand-lead-time buffering essential. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy is recommended with a safety stock of 22,024 units (z=1.645, 95% SL) and a storage-capacity-capped order quantity of 10,416 units. This replaces the current zero-safety-stock, MOQ-only policy which generates >21,000 micro-orders per year at a cost of over $1M annually.
warnings: Storage capacity constraint is binding: unconstrained EOQ would exceed max_storage_units; order quantity capped at floor(32440.66 - 22024) = 10416.
Lead time is unstable (CV=0.665): safety stock formula uses full combined variance.
Demand trend detected: policy parameters should be reviewed quarterly.
SAP safety stock of 0 provides no service-level buffer for this erratic demand pattern.

research_insights.selected_model: (r, Q) continuous-review with EOQ order sizing
research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is near-continuous (99% non-zero days) and erratic (CV=0.42), making a continuous-review (r,Q) model the appropriate choice over periodic review. EOQ balances the low ordering cost ($50) against the meaningful holding cost rate (12%) at high annual volumes (~3M units). MOQ of 140 is far below EOQ, so EOQ governs sizing subject to the capacity cap.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity binds: safety_stock (22,024) + order_quantity (10,416) = 32,440 ≤ 32,440.66 — feasible but at full capacity. Any upward revision to safety stock (e.g., from demand trend) would require either a reduction in order quantity or a storage expansion. Service level risk if capacity cannot accommodate safety stock growth.
research_insights.escalation_flag: none — MOQ (140) + safety_stock (22,024) = 22,164 is well within max_storage_units (32,440.66); no MOQ-capacity infeasibility.
